assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait background artwork behind real HTML game-menu controls for TURNTALE, a cozy hand-painted fantasy tile board game. Create ONE polished full-bleed 2:3 portrait bitmap. A tasteful carved walnut and antique-brass frame around a deep dark quiet central panel, warm amber rim light, rounded hand-painted storybook fantasy styling, tactile wood and softly worn metal, restrained elegant gold ornament. This is background artwork only, not a screenshot, not a completed UI layout. Keep the central 75 percent very calm, dark, low-contrast and open so real headings, input fields, buttons and character cards will be readable on top. Concentrate visual interest in the upper 18 percent and outer corners/edges; no large objects across the central area. Broad softly painted shapes and smooth finished surfaces, not scratchy sketch lines. The edges form one unified decorative panel rather than multiple boxes. No text, lettering, logos, numerals, labels, buttons, icons of controls, card grids, characters or people. Do not bake in interface elements or legible playing tiles. No watermark.  Theme: selecting an adventure in a welcoming moonlit fantasy inn. The upper edge suggests a carved rounded arch, muted burgundy drapery, one tiny warm lantern near an outer corner, distant soft blue moonlit window glow and a small elegant four-suit brass ornament at the very top edge. Deep forest-green velvet/wood in the calm center. Rich brown walnut frame, subtle antique-gold highlights. Cozy, inviting, visually related to a magical board-game tavern.
assets.editPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this generated TURNTALE menu background. Keep the whole composition, frame, lantern, curtains, moonlit window, colors, lighting and dark empty central field unchanged. Change ONLY the small gold four-symbol crest at the top center. Replace the poker/card-suit shapes with the game's four simple gold symbols: a circular SUN with short rays, a five-point STAR, a CRESCENT MOON, and a soft puffy CLOUD. Arrange those four symbols as a tasteful compact 2-by-2 crest in the existing carved position. No hearts, spades, clubs or diamonds. No words or numerals. Preserve full opaque background and portrait canvas.
